name: SimplePractice
short_description: All-in-one practice management and EHR platform for health and wellness professionals with scheduling, documentation, billing, telehealth, and client portal.
long_description: SimplePractice is a comprehensive practice management platform designed for health and wellness professionals including therapists, counselors, psychologists, social workers, and nutritionists. Founded in 2012 in Santa Monica, California, the platform serves over 250,000 practitioners with an integrated suite of tools covering client scheduling, electronic health records, secure documentation, automated billing, payment processing, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, and a client portal. The platform is known for its user-friendly interface and robust feature set that enables clinicians to manage their entire practice from one system. SimplePractice offers AI-powered note-taking, e-prescribing capabilities, and integrates with major calendar systems including Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Microsoft Outlook.
one_liner: The leading all-in-one practice management platform for therapists and health professionals.
best_for: Solo therapists and counselors seeking an all-in-one practice management solution
Small to medium group practices (2-50 providers) needing integrated scheduling, billing, and documentation
Insurance-heavy practices requiring electronic claims submission and eligibility verification
Psychiatrists and prescribers needing e-prescribing capabilities (add-on available)
Telehealth-first practices wanting built-in HIPAA-compliant video sessions
not_for: Large enterprise behavioral health organizations (50+ providers)
Community mental health centers needing complex reporting and state compliance
Practices requiring specialized addiction treatment or residential program workflows
Budget-conscious solo practitioners (starts at $49/mo, adds up with e-prescribing and AI add-ons)

pricing.notes: Three tiers: Starter ($49/mo), Essential ($79/mo), Plus ($99/mo). Additional providers on Plus plan: $74/mo. Custom pricing for 6+ practitioners.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: Core features: scheduling, documentation, client portal, unlimited clients. No telehealth.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.description: Most popular. All Starter features plus telehealth, appointment reminders, secure messaging, insurance billing.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.description: Full suite: group appointments, group telehealth, advanced calendar, premium support, professional website.

tiers.name: Plus (Additional Clinician)
tiers.description: For group practices on Plus plan. Each additional clinician after the first.

care_aide_ai.description: AI-powered Note Taker, Session Sidekick for telehealth, treatment planning, client summaries. 30-day free trial.

e_prescribing.description: E-prescribing with EPCS for controlled substances (Schedule II-V) via DrFirst. Required for psychiatrists/PMHNPs.

wiley_treatment_planners.description: Access to Wiley Treatment Planner library with evidence-based treatment plan templates.

faqs.q: How much does SimplePractice cost per month in 2026?
faqs.a: SimplePractice offers three pricing tiers: Starter at $49/month, Essential at $79/month, and Plus at $99/month. Annual plans save approximately 2 months. Additional features like AI Note Taker ($35/mo) and e-Prescribing ($49/mo) are available as add-ons.

faqs.q: Is SimplePractice HIPAA compliant with a BAA?
faqs.a: Yes, SimplePractice is fully HIPAA compliant and provides a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) to all users. The platform includes encrypted telehealth, secure messaging, and protected health information storage.

faqs.q: Does SimplePractice offer telehealth video sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, SimplePractice includes built-in HIPAA-compliant telehealth video sessions on the Essential and Plus plans. The telehealth feature supports HD video, screen sharing, and includes a virtual waiting room.

faqs.q: Can SimplePractice handle insurance billing for therapists?
faqs.a: Yes, SimplePractice supports insurance billing with electronic claims submission at $0.25 per claim. It includes eligibility verification, superbill generation, and integrates with clearinghouses for ERA processing.

SimplePractice is best for solo therapists, counselors, and small to medium group practices (up to 50 providers) seeking an all-in-one practice management solution. It works well for mental health clinicians wanting built-in HIPAA-compliant telehealth and those transitioning from paper-based systems.

SimplePractice integrates with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Microsoft Outlook for scheduling. It also integrates with Stripe for payment processing, Zoom for telehealth, Change Healthcare for electronic claims, and DrFirst for e-prescribing.
